reference.description: Existing archived multi-provider consensus, copied byte for byte; this baseline is not independent publisher gold.

headlineMetric: The standard report uses lexical-normalized WER/CER. These separate fidelity diagnostics preserve punctuation, case, glyphs and formatting.
pageBoundaryPolicy: The archived consensus parser removes page wrappers and trims page edges; candidate page edges receive the same treatment before strict diagnostics.

providers.policy: Case-sensitive code tokens preserve identifiers, operators, quotes and punctuation. Indentation compares original leading space/tab characters at corresponding line positions; tabs are not silently expanded. Only CRLF/CR and final-newline convention are normalized.
